name: disk_pressure_act_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: DISK_PRESSURE_ACT_20261103 — operator disk permanent-fix items 3 and 4 (2026-11-03): the 85% pressure guard triggers the reviewed cleaner only when the operator-armed switch is on (ships OFF), and a disk incident is dispatched to the fixer instead of being parked as needs_operator. Covers the four required behaviours: below threshold, disarmed, armed+eligible, armed+zero-eligible.
